problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description_short: Practice key/value lookup using JavaScript Objects or Hash Maps.
problems.learning_note: Use an object/map to store previously seen numbers for O(1) lookup.

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.description_short: Search for target in a sorted integer array in O(log n) time.
problems.learning_note: Classic binary search: compare target against mid, halving search range repeatedly.

problems.title: Add Two Integers
problems.description_short: Return the sum of two integer variables.
problems.learning_note: Simple variable storage and return value practice.

problems.title: Create Hello World Function
problems.description_short: Write a function that always returns a 'Hello World' closure.
problems.learning_note: Understand how JavaScript functions capture outer scope and return values.

problems.title: Counter
problems.description_short: Given an integer n, return a counter function that returns n, then n + 1 on each call.
problems.learning_note: Introduces closures and persistent variable state in function execution memory.

problems.title: Counter II
problems.description_short: Create a counter object with increment, decrement, and reset methods.
problems.learning_note: Demonstrates object methods sharing closure state across invocations.

problems.title: To Be Or Not To Be
problems.description_short: Implement an assertion function expecting toBe and notToBe helper methods.
problems.learning_note: Practices chaining object methods with conditional throwing of errors.

problems.title: Palindrome Number
problems.description_short: Determine whether an integer is a palindrome without converting to string.
problems.learning_note: Pure primitive number manipulation and digit extraction.

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.description_short: Determine if an integer is a power of two using recursive division.
problems.learning_note: Focus on primitive number properties and base case reduction.

problems.title: Add Digits
problems.description_short: Repeatedly sum digits of a non-negative integer until only one digit remains.
problems.learning_note: Can be solved with an iterative loop or O(1) mathematical digital root arithmetic.

problems.title: Subtract the Product and Sum of Digits of an Integer
problems.description_short: Calculate the difference between the product of digits and the sum of digits of an integer.
problems.learning_note: Extract digits using modulo 10 and integer division in an iterative loop.

problems.title: Plus One
problems.description_short: Increment a large integer represented as an array of decimal digits by one.
problems.learning_note: Traverse from the least significant digit right-to-left handling carry operations.

problems.title: Roman to Integer
problems.description_short: Convert a Roman numeral string into its integer representation.
problems.learning_note: Check if the current symbol is smaller than the next symbol to subtract or add.

problems.title: Reverse Integer
problems.description_short: Reverse decimal digits of a 32-bit signed integer and handle overflow boundaries.
problems.learning_note: Extract digits using modulo and guard against 32-bit signed integer overflow limits.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.description_short: Check if any value appears at least twice using an object hash map for fast membership check.
problems.learning_note: Shows the power of key lookup in objects versus linear search.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.description_short: Determine if string t is an anagram of s by counting frequency of primitive chars using an object.
problems.learning_note: Demonstrates object hash mapping for character frequency tracking.

problems.title: First Unique Character in a String
problems.description_short: Find the first non-repeating character using object frequency counting.
problems.learning_note: Combines object property accumulation with string iteration.

problems.title: Ransom Note
problems.description_short: Determine if magazine letters can construct the ransom note string.
problems.learning_note: Count character frequencies using an object hash map and decrement for note characters.

problems.title: Is Object Empty
problems.description_short: Check whether a given object or array is empty in O(1) without extra space.
problems.learning_note: Use Object.keys(obj).length or for...in loop early return for objects and arrays.

problems.title: Array Wrapper
problems.description_short: Create a class wrapper around an array supporting addition and string conversion.
problems.learning_note: Implement valueOf and toString methods for JavaScript primitive coercion.

problems.title: Join Two Arrays by ID
problems.description_short: Join two arrays of objects by an id field, merging attributes for matching keys.
problems.learning_note: Use an object map keyed by id to achieve an efficient O(n + m) merge.

problems.title: Compact Object
problems.description_short: Recursively remove all falsy values from a nested JSON object or array.
problems.learning_note: Recursively traverse nested objects and arrays while filtering out Boolean(val) === false.

problems.title: Function Composition
problems.description_short: Given an array of functions, return a composition function.
problems.learning_note: Deepens understanding of function calls, parameters, and return values.

problems.title: Filter Elements from Array
problems.description_short: Implement a custom filter function without using Array.prototype.filter.
problems.learning_note: Practice passing functions as arguments and managing return values.

problems.title: Return Length of Arguments Passed
problems.description_short: Return the count of arguments passed to a function using rest parameters.
problems.learning_note: Illustrates the JavaScript rest operator (...args) and arguments array length.

problems.title: Allow One Function Call
problems.description_short: Wrap a function so it can only ever be invoked at most once.
problems.learning_note: Use a boolean closure flag to gate subsequent function invocations.

problems.title: Sleep
problems.description_short: Create an asynchronous sleep function that pauses execution for millis milliseconds.
problems.learning_note: Utilizes JavaScript Promises and setTimeout to handle asynchronous timing.

problems.title: Memoize
problems.description_short: Memoize a function so duplicate calls with the same arguments return cached results.
problems.learning_note: Demonstrates caching computation results in a Map keyed by serialized arguments.

problems.title: Debounce
problems.description_short: Implement a debounce function that delays invocation until t milliseconds of inactivity.
problems.learning_note: Fundamental frontend optimization technique utilizing clearTimeout and setTimeout.

problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.description_short: Practice recursive calls, base cases, and function call stacks.
problems.learning_note: A classic example of recursion where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones.

problems.title: Reverse String
problems.description_short: Write a function that reverses a string in-place with recursion or two pointers.
problems.learning_note: Great practice for recursion base cases and string array manipulation.

problems.title: Pow(x, n)
problems.description_short: Calculate x raised to the power n using logarithmic recursion.
problems.learning_note: Divide-and-conquer recursion reducing O(n) to O(log n).

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.description_short: Count distinct ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at each stride.
problems.learning_note: Directly maps to the Fibonacci recurrence relation f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2).

problems.title: N-th Tribonacci Number
problems.description_short: Calculate the n-th Tribonacci number where each term sums the preceding three terms.
problems.learning_note: Extension of Fibonacci with three base cases: T0=0, T1=1, T2=1.

problems.title: Power of Three
problems.description_short: Check if an integer is a power of three using recursive division or math properties.
problems.learning_note: Repeatedly divide by 3 while checking remainder === 0 down to base case 1.

problems.title: Power of Four
problems.description_short: Determine if an integer is a power of four using bit manipulation or recursion.
problems.learning_note: Check if positive, power of two, and has set bit only at odd bit positions (num & 0x55555555).

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.description_short: Reverse a singly linked list in-place using three pointers: prev, curr, next.
problems.learning_note: Classic 3-pointer in-place reversal. Iterative is O(n) time O(1) space.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.description_short: Merge two sorted linked lists and return as one sorted list using a dummy node.
problems.learning_note: Use a dummy sentinel head node to simplify boundary conditions in pointer merging.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.description_short: Generate the complete power set (all subsets) of an array of unique integers.
problems.learning_note: Classic backtracking decision tree: at each index, choose to include or exclude the element.

problems.title: Combinations
problems.description_short: Generate all possible combinations of k numbers chosen from range 1 through n.
problems.learning_note: Build combinations recursively by pruning search branches where remaining elements are insufficient.

problems.title: Generate Parentheses
problems.description_short: Generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses for n pairs.
problems.learning_note: Recursively branch: add '(' if open < n, and add ')' if close < open.

problems.title: Squares of a Sorted Array
problems.description_short: Given a sorted array of integers, return squares sorted in non-decreasing order.
problems.learning_note: Compare absolute values at both ends with two pointers to achieve linear O(n) time.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.description_short: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum using Kadane's algorithm.
problems.learning_note: Kadane's algorithm maintains current_sum = max(num, current_sum + num) in O(n) time and O(1) space.

problems.title: Move Zeroes
problems.description_short: Move all zeroes to the end of an array while maintaining relative order of non-zero elements.
problems.learning_note: Use a slow pointer to place non-zero elements and fill remainder with zeroes in-place O(1) space.

problems.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
problems.description_short: Remove duplicates in-place from a sorted array and return the count of unique elements.
problems.learning_note: Two-pointer technique where slow pointer only advances when a new unique value is encountered.

problems.title: Remove Element
problems.description_short: Remove all instances of a target value in-place from an array and return new length.
problems.learning_note: Overwrite matched elements using two pointers without allocating secondary array space.

problems.title: Merge Sorted Array
problems.description_short: Merge two sorted integer arrays nums1 and nums2 into a single sorted array.
problems.learning_note: Fill elements backwards from index m + n - 1 to merge in-place in linear time.

problems.title: Rotate Array
problems.description_short: Rotate an array to the right by k steps in O(1) extra auxiliary space.
problems.learning_note: Triple reverse algorithm: reverse entire array, reverse first k, reverse remaining n-k elements.

problems.title: Fizz Buzz
problems.description_short: Return array of strings where multiples of 3 are 'Fizz', 5 are 'Buzz', and both are 'FizzBuzz'.
problems.learning_note: Classic control flow problem demonstrating conditional branch ordering and modulo arithmetic.

problems.title: Sign of the Product of an Array
problems.description_short: Return 1, -1, or 0 based on the sign of the product of all array elements.
problems.learning_note: Avoid computing the actual product to prevent integer overflow; simply count negative numbers.

problems.title: Count of Matches in Tournament
problems.description_short: Calculate the total number of matches played in an elimination tournament until a winner is crowned.
problems.learning_note: Each match eliminates exactly one team; hence n teams require exactly n - 1 matches.

problems.title: Happy Number
problems.description_short: Determine if a number is happy by repeatedly replacing it with the sum of squares of its digits.
problems.learning_note: Detect infinite cycles using Floyd's cycle detection (fast/slow pointers) or a hash set.

problems.title: Merge Strings Alternately
problems.description_short: Merge two strings by alternating characters from each string.
problems.learning_note: Iterate up to max length of both strings and append characters alternately.

problems.title: Running Sum of 1d Array
problems.description_short: Return running sum of an array where runningSum[i] = sum(nums[0]...nums[i]).
problems.learning_note: Compute prefix sums in linear time by adding each number to the accumulated running total.

problems.title: Shuffle the Array
problems.description_short: Shuffle the array [x1, x2, ..., xn, y1, y2, ..., yn] into [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...].
problems.learning_note: Interleave elements from index i and index i + n into a new result array.

problems.title: Sort Array By Parity
problems.description_short: Rearrange array so that all even integers precede all odd integers.
problems.learning_note: Two-pointer swap or custom comparator using JavaScript Array.prototype.sort.

problems.title: Intersection of Two Arrays
problems.description_short: Given two integer arrays, return an array of their unique intersection elements.
problems.learning_note: Convert the first array into a Set for O(1) membership lookup against the second array.

problems.title: Chunk Array
problems.description_short: Split an array into sub-arrays of maximum specified size chunk.
problems.learning_note: Iterate with step size equal to chunk and slice subarrays using Array.prototype.slice.

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.description_short: Group strings that are anagrams of each other together.
problems.learning_note: Map character frequency counts or sorted string signatures to lists of words.

problems.title: Apply Transform Over Each Element in Array
problems.description_short: Implement a custom map function without Array.prototype.map.
problems.learning_note: Iterate through elements passing (arr[i], i) to the transformation callback.

problems.title: Array Reduce Transformation
problems.description_short: Implement a custom reduce function that accumulates array values into a single result.
problems.learning_note: Initialize accumulator with init and successively apply the reducer function.

problems.title: Sort By
problems.description_short: Sort an array based on the numeric value returned by a mapping callback function.
problems.learning_note: Custom comparator sorting using fn(a) - fn(b) in JavaScript sort.

problems.title: Group By
problems.description_short: Add a groupBy method to all arrays returning an object keyed by callback results.
problems.learning_note: Extends Array.prototype to categorize elements into bucket arrays in an object.

problems.title: Flatten Deeply Nested Array
problems.description_short: Flatten a multi-dimensional array up to a specified maximum depth n.
problems.learning_note: Recursive traversal decreasing depth counter at each nested array level.

problems.title: Event Emitter
problems.description_short: Design an EventEmitter class with subscribe and emit event pub-sub methods.
problems.learning_note: Stores event listener callback arrays inside a Map or Object.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.description_short: Find the maximum profit by choosing a single buy and sell day in a prices array.
problems.learning_note: Classic array sliding window / greedy single-pass with O(n) time.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.description_short: Given an array containing n distinct numbers in range [0, n], find the missing number.
problems.learning_note: Use Gauss formula sum or XOR trick to find the gap in O(n) time with O(1) space.

problems.title: Single Number
problems.description_short: Every element appears twice except for one. Find the unique element using XOR.
problems.learning_note: XOR of a number with itself is 0; XOR of a number with 0 is the number. Great bitwise pattern.

problems.title: Majority Element
problems.description_short: Find the majority element that appears more than ⌊n / 2⌋ times.
problems.learning_note: Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm achieves O(n) time and O(1) space by tracking a candidate and count.

problems.title: Pascal's Triangle
problems.description_short: Generate the first numRows of Pascal's triangle.
problems.learning_note: Each entry is computed by summing the two adjacent values directly above it: row[j] = prev[j-1] + prev[j].

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.description_short: Calculate an array where each element is the product of all elements except itself without division.
problems.learning_note: Two passes: prefix products left-to-right, then suffix products right-to-left in O(n) time.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.description_short: Use two pointers scanning inward to check if a string is a palindrome (ignoring non-alphanumeric).
problems.learning_note: Classic two-pointer string pattern: left and right pointers moving toward the center.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.description_short: Determine if a string of brackets is valid using a stack to match opening and closing pairs.
problems.learning_note: The stack LIFO property matches exactly the closing bracket to the most recent opening bracket.

problems.title: Longest Common Prefix
problems.description_short: Find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings.
problems.learning_note: Horizontal or vertical scanning: compare character by character across all strings.

problems.title: Reverse Vowels of a String
problems.description_short: Reverse only the vowels in a given string while leaving consonants in place.
problems.learning_note: Two pointers from start and end moving inward, swapping only when both point to vowels.

problems.title: Is Subsequence
problems.description_short: Determine if string s is a valid subsequence of string t.
problems.learning_note: Two pointers advancing pointer on t and advancing pointer on s on each character match.

problems.title: Longest Palindrome
problems.description_short: Find the length of the longest palindrome that can be built with letters of a string.
problems.learning_note: Count character frequencies; all pairs contribute 2, plus at most one odd center character.

problems.title: Add Strings
problems.description_short: Add two non-negative numbers represented as strings without converting them directly to BigInt.
problems.learning_note: Simulate elementary column addition from right-to-left tracking carry.

problems.title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
problems.description_short: Find the index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack, or -1 if needle is not part of haystack.
problems.learning_note: Slide a window of needle length across haystack, or implement KMP algorithm for linear time.

problems.title: Length of Last Word
problems.description_short: Return the length of the last word consisting of non-space characters in a string.
problems.learning_note: Scan from the end of the string skipping trailing whitespace and count until the next space.

problems.title: Isomorphic Strings
problems.description_short: Determine if two strings s and t are isomorphic with consistent character mappings.
problems.learning_note: Track bidirectional character mappings using two hash maps or last-seen index arrays.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.description_short: Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
problems.learning_note: Sliding window with a hash map storing the most recent index of each character.

problems.title: Middle of the Linked List
problems.description_short: Find the middle node of a singly linked list in one pass using Fast + Slow pointers.
problems.learning_note: Slow pointer moves 1 step; fast moves 2. When fast reaches end, slow is at middle.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.description_short: Detect a cycle in a linked list using Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm.
problems.learning_note: If fast and slow pointers ever meet, a cycle exists. O(n) time, O(1) space.

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.description_short: Remove the nth node from the end in one pass using two pointers with a gap of n.
problems.learning_note: Advance first pointer n steps, then move both until first reaches end. Second is at target.

problems.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List
problems.description_short: Delete duplicates from a sorted linked list so each element appears only once.
problems.learning_note: If curr.val === curr.next.val, skip the next node by curr.next = curr.next.next.

problems.title: Remove Linked List Elements
problems.description_short: Remove all nodes from a linked list that have value equal to val.
problems.learning_note: Use a dummy head sentinel node to cleanly handle deletion of the first node.

problems.title: Palindrome Linked List
problems.description_short: Determine if a singly linked list is a palindrome in O(n) time and O(1) space.
problems.learning_note: Find midpoint using slow/fast pointers, reverse second half, and compare values.

problems.title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
problems.description_short: Find the node at which the intersection of two singly linked lists begins.
problems.learning_note: Two pointers traversing headA then headB: they align at intersection after at most two passes.

problems.title: Design Linked List
problems.description_short: Implement a linked list from scratch with get, addAtHead, addAtTail, addAtIndex, and deleteAtIndex.
problems.learning_note: Great exercise comparing singly vs doubly linked implementations with dummy sentinel nodes.

problems.title: Add Two Numbers
problems.description_short: Add two numbers represented by linked lists with digits stored in reverse order.
problems.learning_note: Traverse both lists node by node, propagating carry to each sum.

problems.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
problems.description_short: Swap every two adjacent nodes in a linked list and return its new head.
problems.learning_note: Rearrange node pointers pairwise using a dummy node without modifying node values.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle II
problems.description_short: Find the exact node where a linked list cycle begins, or return null if no cycle.
problems.learning_note: Floyd's algorithm: after slow and fast meet, reset one pointer to head; both advance at 1x to meet at cycle start.

problems.title: Delete Node in a Linked List
problems.description_short: Delete a given node in a singly linked list with only access to that node.
problems.learning_note: Copy the value of the next node into the current node, then bypass the next node.

problems.title: Odd Even Linked List
problems.description_short: Group all odd-indexed nodes together followed by even-indexed nodes.
problems.learning_note: Maintain odd and even pointer chains simultaneously, then attach evenHead to the end of odd chain.

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.description_short: Reorder a linked list to L0 → Ln → L1 → Ln-1 → L2 → Ln-2 → … in-place.
problems.learning_note: Find middle, reverse the second half, and interleave nodes from both halves.

problems.title: Design Browser History
problems.description_short: Design a browser history with visit, back, and forward steps.
problems.learning_note: Naturally modeled with a doubly linked list or dynamic array with a current pointer.

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.description_short: Design an LRU cache with O(1) get and put using a Doubly Linked List + Hash Map.
problems.learning_note: DLL enables O(1) node re-ordering; HashMap provides O(1) key-to-node lookup.

problems.title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
problems.description_short: Flatten a doubly linked list that may have child nodes into a single-level list.
problems.learning_note: Use DFS or an explicit stack to splice child sublists into the main DLL in-place.

problems.title: Baseball Game
problems.description_short: Record scores in a baseball game according to integer, '+', 'D', and 'C' operations.
problems.learning_note: Stack simulates operations directly: push numbers, double top, sum top two, or pop invalid scores.

problems.title: Backspace String Compare
problems.description_short: Compare two strings containing '#' representing backspace characters.
problems.learning_note: Build final strings using a stack, or traverse backwards with two pointers in O(1) space.

problems.title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
problems.description_short: Repeatedly remove all adjacent duplicate characters in a string until none remain.
problems.learning_note: Push characters to stack; if incoming character equals stack top, pop stack top instead.

problems.title: Make The String Great
problems.description_short: Make a string great by removing adjacent letters that are the same char with differing cases.
problems.learning_note: Stack comparison: remove top when Math.abs(curr.charCodeAt() - top.charCodeAt()) === 32.

problems.title: Next Greater Element I
problems.description_short: Find the next greater element for each value in subset array nums1 within nums2.
problems.learning_note: Monotonic decreasing stack computes next greater elements for all numbers in nums2 into a map.

problems.title: Implement Stack using Queues
problems.description_short: Simulate a LIFO stack using only FIFO queue operations.
problems.learning_note: Rotate all elements except the last one on each push to maintain LIFO order.

problems.title: Implement Queue using Stacks
problems.description_short: Simulate a FIFO queue using two LIFO stacks for amortized O(1) dequeue.
problems.learning_note: Push to 'inStack'. On dequeue, if 'outStack' is empty, pour all of inStack into outStack.

problems.title: Min Stack
problems.description_short: Design a stack that retrieves the minimum element in O(1) using a dual tracking stack.
problems.learning_note: Maintain a secondary 'minStack' that tracks the current minimum at each stack state.

problems.title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
problems.description_short: Evaluate arithmetic expressions in Reverse Polish Notation (postfix).
problems.learning_note: Stack holds operands; when an operator is encountered, pop two operands and push the result.

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.description_short: Find the number of days to wait until a warmer temperature for each day in temperatures.
problems.learning_note: Monotonic decreasing stack stores indices; pop whenever the current temperature exceeds stack top.

problems.title: Number of Recent Calls
problems.description_short: Count the number of recent requests within the past 3000 milliseconds window.
problems.learning_note: Queue holds timestamps; pop all timestamps older than t - 3000 on each ping.

problems.title: Number of Students Unable to Eat Lunch
problems.description_short: Count number of students unable to eat given sandwich preferences and a circular stack of sandwiches.
problems.learning_note: Simulate queue rotation or count student preferences until no student takes the top sandwich.

problems.title: Design Circular Queue
problems.description_short: Implement a circular queue with front/rear modulo pointer wrap-around for O(1) operations.
problems.learning_note: Use a fixed-size array with (rear + 1) % capacity to wrap the rear pointer back to slot 0.

problems.title: Design Circular Deque
problems.description_short: Design a circular double-ended queue (deque) supporting insert and delete at both ends.
problems.learning_note: Use a fixed-size circular buffer with front and rear pointers using modulo arithmetic.

problems.title: Richest Customer Wealth
problems.description_short: Find the maximum wealth among customers where wealth is the sum of bank account deposits.
problems.learning_note: Iterate across matrix rows, sum each row, and track maximum row sum.

problems.title: Max Consecutive Ones
problems.description_short: Find the maximum number of consecutive 1s in a binary array.
problems.learning_note: Single linear scan tracking consecutive 1 count and resetting on 0.

problems.title: Find Numbers with Even Number of Digits
problems.description_short: Count how many numbers in an array contain an even number of decimal digits.
problems.learning_note: Convert numbers to string or count digits with Math.floor(Math.log10(n)) + 1.

problems.title: Find Pivot Index
problems.description_short: Find the pivot index where the sum of numbers strictly to the left equals the sum strictly to the right.
problems.learning_note: Compute total sum first; as you scan, check if leftSum === totalSum - leftSum - num.

problems.title: Search Insert Position
problems.description_short: Find the index of target in sorted array, or index where it would be if inserted in order.
problems.learning_note: Binary search returning the low pointer boundary when target is not found.

problems.title: Sqrt(x)
problems.description_short: Compute integer square root of non-negative integer x without using built-in exponent functions.
problems.learning_note: Binary search in range [0, x] finding the largest integer mid where mid * mid <= x.

problems.title: First Bad Version
problems.description_short: Find the first bad version in an API release chain using minimum calls to isBadVersion(version).
problems.learning_note: Binary search finding the leftmost boundary where isBadVersion returns true.

problems.title: Valid Perfect Square
problems.description_short: Determine if a positive integer num is a valid perfect square without built-in sqrt.
problems.learning_note: Binary search mid in [1, num] testing if mid * mid === num.

problems.title: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
problems.description_short: Find the smallest character in sorted letters array that is lexicographically greater than target.
problems.learning_note: Binary search for upper bound with circular wrap-around to letters[0].

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problems.description_short: Find the starting and ending position of a given target value in a sorted array.
problems.learning_note: Run binary search twice: once finding leftmost occurrence and once finding rightmost occurrence.

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.description_short: Search for target in a sorted array that has been rotated at an unknown pivot index.
problems.learning_note: One half of a rotated sorted array is always strictly sorted; check which half to discard.

problems.title: Search a 2D Matrix
problems.description_short: Search for target value in an m x n matrix where each row is sorted and begins after previous row.
problems.learning_note: Treat the 2D matrix as a virtual 1D array of length m * n with binary search.

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.description_short: Find the minimum element in a sorted rotated array of unique elements in O(log n) time.
problems.learning_note: Compare nums[mid] with nums[high]: if nums[mid] > nums[high], the minimum lies in the right half.

problems.title: Find Peak Element
problems.description_short: Find a peak element that is strictly greater than its neighbors in O(log n) time.
problems.learning_note: Binary search following the ascending slope: if nums[mid] < nums[mid + 1], a peak exists to the right.

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.description_short: Find minimum eating speed k to eat all bananas within h hours.
problems.learning_note: Binary search on the answer range [1, max(piles)] verifying feasible hours at each mid speed.

problems.title: Sort an Array
problems.description_short: Sort an array of integers in ascending order in O(n log n) time.
problems.learning_note: Implement Merge Sort or randomized Quick Sort to avoid worst-case O(n²) performance.

problems.title: Sort Array By Parity II
problems.description_short: Sort array so that even indices have even integers and odd indices have odd integers.
problems.learning_note: Use two pointers for even and odd index slots and swap misplaced elements.

problems.title: Height Checker
problems.description_short: Find count of students not standing in non-decreasing order of heights.
problems.learning_note: Compare original heights against sorted copy, or use counting sort in O(n) time.

problems.title: Array Partition
problems.description_short: Maximize the sum of min(ai, bi) for all pairs in an array of 2n integers.
problems.learning_note: Sorting pairs adjacent elements together, minimizing wasted value differences.

problems.title: Sort Array by Increasing Frequency
problems.description_short: Sort array by increasing frequency of values, breaking ties by decreasing numeric value.
problems.learning_note: Count frequencies in hash map and supply custom sort comparator: freq[a] - freq[b] || b - a.

problems.title: Insertion Sort List
problems.description_short: Sort a singly linked list using the insertion sort algorithm.
problems.learning_note: Maintain a sorted sublist chain and iteratively insert each node into its correct location.

problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.description_short: Merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of non-overlapping intervals.
problems.learning_note: Sort intervals by start time, then merge if current start <= previous end.

problems.title: Sort List
problems.description_short: Sort a linked list in O(n log n) time and O(log n) memory using Merge Sort.
problems.learning_note: Find list middle using slow/fast pointers, split, recursively sort halves, and merge.

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
problems.description_short: Merge k sorted linked lists and return it as one sorted list.
problems.learning_note: Use a min-heap priority queue or divide-and-conquer pairwise merge in O(N log k) time.

problems.title: Sort Colors
problems.description_short: Sort an array containing 0s, 1s, and 2s in-place in one pass (Dutch National Flag problem).
problems.learning_note: Three pointers (low, mid, high): partition array into sections of 0s, 1s, and 2s.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.description_short: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array without fully sorting the entire array.
problems.learning_note: Quickselect algorithm achieves average O(n) time; min-heap of size k achieves O(n log k).

problems.title: Word Pattern
problems.description_short: Determine if a string s follows the exact word pattern of characters.
problems.learning_note: Split string into words and enforce bijection between pattern characters and words.

problems.title: Design HashMap
problems.description_short: Design a HashMap without using built-in hash table libraries.
problems.learning_note: Implement hash function with modulo and handle collisions via separate chaining with buckets.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.description_short: Find the k most frequent elements in an integer array.
problems.learning_note: Count frequencies with a hash map, then use Bucket Sort in O(n) or a min-heap in O(n log k).

problems.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
problems.description_short: Find the total number of continuous subarrays whose sum equals k.
problems.learning_note: Prefix sum with hash map: count how many times (currSum - k) has previously appeared.

problems.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
problems.description_short: Find the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence in O(n) time.
problems.learning_note: Insert all numbers into a HashSet; only start counting sequences when num - 1 is not in the set.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate II
problems.description_short: Check if array contains duplicate values with indices differing by at most k.
problems.learning_note: Sliding window of size k using a HashSet, or hash map storing last seen index of each element.

problems.title: Design HashSet
problems.description_short: Design a HashSet without using any built-in hash table libraries.
problems.learning_note: Use an array of buckets and separate chaining linked lists or arrays for collision handling.

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.description_short: Find the maximum depth (height) of a binary tree.
problems.learning_note: Recursively compute 1 + max(maxDepth(root.left), maxDepth(root.right)) with base case root === null.

problems.title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
problems.description_short: Return the inorder traversal (left → node → right) of a binary tree's node values.
problems.learning_note: Traverse recursively or iteratively with a stack; visits BST nodes in non-decreasing sorted order.

problems.title: Binary Tree Preorder Traversal
problems.description_short: Return the preorder traversal (node → left → right) of a binary tree's values.
problems.learning_note: Root node is processed first before visiting left and right child subtrees.

problems.title: Binary Tree Postorder Traversal
problems.description_short: Return the postorder traversal (left → right → node) of a binary tree's values.
problems.learning_note: Subtree children are processed completely before processing their parent node.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.description_short: Invert a binary tree by swapping the left and right subtrees of every node.
problems.learning_note: Recursively swap root.left and root.right down to leaf nodes.

problems.title: Same Tree
problems.description_short: Check if two binary trees are structurally identical with equal node values.
problems.learning_note: Compare current node values, then recursively check left subtrees and right subtrees.

problems.title: Symmetric Tree
problems.description_short: Check whether a binary tree is a mirror reflection of itself (symmetric).
problems.learning_note: Helper function compares t1.left with t2.right and t1.right with t2.left.

problems.title: Balanced Binary Tree
problems.description_short: Determine if a binary tree is height-balanced (subtree heights differ by at most 1).
problems.learning_note: Bottom-up DFS returns tree height or -1 immediately when any subtree is unbalanced.

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.description_short: Compute the diameter of a binary tree (length of longest path between any two nodes).
problems.learning_note: At each node, the longest path passing through it is leftHeight + rightHeight.

problems.title: Path Sum
problems.description_short: Determine if tree has a root-to-leaf path summing to targetSum.
problems.learning_note: Subtract node value at each recursive step, returning true when a leaf has remaining targetSum === 0.

problems.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.description_short: Return the level order traversal (breadth-first) of binary tree node values.
problems.learning_note: BFS using a queue, processing one complete level per outer loop iteration.

problems.title: Search in a Binary Search Tree
problems.description_short: Search for a node in a Binary Search Tree (BST) with a given target value.
problems.learning_note: Leverage BST ordering: move left if target < root.val, otherwise move right.

problems.title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
problems.description_short: Convert a sorted array into a height-balanced Binary Search Tree.
problems.learning_note: Choose the middle element as root, recursively building left and right subtrees from array halves.

problems.title: Insert into a Binary Search Tree
problems.description_short: Insert a new value into a Binary Search Tree while preserving the BST property.
problems.learning_note: Traverse down comparing val; attach a new TreeNode when reaching an empty child reference.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.description_short: Determine if a binary tree is a valid Binary Search Tree (BST).
problems.learning_note: Validate each node falls within valid range (min, max), or check if inorder traversal is strictly increasing.

problems.title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
problems.description_short: Find the kth smallest element in a Binary Search Tree.
problems.learning_note: Inorder traversal visits BST elements in ascending order; return the kth visited node.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
problems.description_short: Find Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) of two given nodes in a Binary Search Tree.
problems.learning_note: If both values are smaller, move left; if both greater, move right; otherwise current node is LCA.

problems.title: Delete Node in a BST
problems.description_short: Delete a node with a given key from a Binary Search Tree.
problems.learning_note: Handle 3 cases: leaf node, one child, or two children (replace with inorder successor).

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
problems.description_short: Design a class to find the kth largest element in a stream of numbers.
problems.learning_note: Maintain a min-heap of fixed size k; the root of the heap is always the kth largest element.

problems.title: Last Stone Weight
problems.description_short: Simulate smashing the two heaviest stones together until at most one remains.
problems.learning_note: Max-heap always gives the two largest stones to subtract and reinsert.

problems.title: K Closest Points to Origin
problems.description_short: Find the k closest points to the origin (0, 0) on the 2D plane.
problems.learning_note: Maintain a max-heap of size k bounded by Euclidean distance, or use Quickselect in linear time.

problems.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
problems.description_short: Implement a Trie with insert, search, and startsWith prefix methods.
problems.learning_note: Each Trie node stores a map/array of 26 child references and an isEndOfWord boolean flag.

problems.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
problems.description_short: Design a data structure supporting adding words and searching with '.' wildcard characters.
problems.learning_note: Trie combined with DFS recursion whenever a '.' wildcard matches any available child node.

problems.title: Word Search II
problems.description_short: Find all words from a dictionary that can be formed in an m x n grid of letters.
problems.learning_note: Trie-based backtracking DFS: pruning search paths that do not exist as prefixes in the dictionary.

problems.title: Find the Town Judge
problems.description_short: Find the town judge who is trusted by everyone but trusts nobody.
problems.learning_note: Track in-degrees and out-degrees: the judge has in-degree == n - 1 and out-degree == 0.

problems.title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
problems.description_short: Determine if there is a valid path between source and destination vertices in an undirected graph.
problems.learning_note: Graph connectivity check using BFS, DFS, or Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find).

problems.title: Clone Graph
problems.description_short: Create a deep copy (clone) of a connected undirected graph.
problems.learning_note: DFS or BFS graph traversal using a hash map to map original nodes to their cloned counterparts.

problems.title: Rotting Oranges
problems.description_short: Find minimum minutes until no fresh orange remains in grid with rotting oranges.
problems.learning_note: Multi-source BFS starting with all initially rotten oranges in the queue simultaneously.

problems.title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
problems.description_short: Find the length of the shortest clear path from top-left to bottom-right in a binary matrix.
problems.learning_note: Breadth-First Search (BFS) explores 8-directional neighbors level-by-level to guarantee shortest path.

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.description_short: Count the number of distinct islands in an m x n binary grid.
problems.learning_note: Traverse grid; on encountering '1', trigger DFS/BFS to sink all connected land cells.

problems.title: Word Ladder
problems.description_short: Find minimum number of words in the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord.
problems.learning_note: BFS on an implicit word graph where edges connect words differing by exactly one character.

problems.title: Flood Fill
problems.description_short: Perform a flood fill on an image starting from pixel (sr, sc) with a new color.
problems.learning_note: Standard 4-directional DFS or BFS recoloring matching adjacent pixels.

problems.title: Max Area of Island
problems.description_short: Find the maximum area of an island of 1s in a 2D binary grid.
problems.learning_note: DFS computes island area by summing 1 for current cell plus recursive areas of all 4 neighbors.

problems.title: All Paths From Source to Target
problems.description_short: Find all possible paths from vertex 0 to vertex n - 1 in a directed acyclic graph (DAG).
problems.learning_note: Backtracking DFS builds paths along outgoing edges; since the graph is a DAG, cycles cannot occur.

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.description_short: Determine if it is possible to finish all courses given prerequisite dependencies.
problems.learning_note: Cycle detection in a directed graph using Kahn's algorithm (topological sort) or DFS with visited states.

problems.title: Course Schedule II
problems.description_short: Return the ordering of courses you should take to finish all courses.
problems.learning_note: Kahn's BFS topological sort using in-degrees: repeatedly queue nodes with in-degree 0.

problems.title: Number of Provinces
problems.description_short: Find total number of provinces (connected components) in an undirected friend graph.
problems.learning_note: Count connected components using Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find) or DFS traversal.

problems.title: Redundant Connection
problems.description_short: Find an edge in a graph that can be removed so the resulting graph is a tree.
problems.learning_note: Union-Find detects cycle: the first edge whose endpoints already belong to the same component is redundant.

problems.title: Number of Operations to Make Network Connected
problems.description_short: Find minimum network cable changes needed to connect all computers.
problems.learning_note: Check if total cables >= n - 1; then minimum operations equals (number of components - 1).

problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.description_short: Calculate minimum time for all nodes to receive a signal sent from source node k.
problems.learning_note: Dijkstra's algorithm with a min-heap priority queue finds shortest path distances in non-negative weighted graphs.

problems.title: Path With Minimum Effort
problems.description_short: Find minimum effort (maximum absolute height difference along a path) from top-left to bottom-right.
problems.learning_note: Modified Dijkstra's algorithm prioritizing minimum maximum-edge-weight, or Binary Search + BFS.

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.description_short: Find cheapest flight from src to dst with at most k stops.
problems.learning_note: Bellman-Ford algorithm with k + 1 iterations, or BFS with distance pruning.

problems.title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
problems.description_short: Find two numbers in a 1-indexed sorted array that add up to target.
problems.learning_note: Two pointers at start and end: adjust based on sum < target (left++) or sum > target (right--).

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.description_short: Find all unique triplets in an array that sum to zero.
problems.learning_note: Sort array, fix first number with an outer loop, then apply two pointers while skipping duplicate values.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.description_short: Find two vertical lines that together with the x-axis form a container holding the most water.
problems.learning_note: Two pointers inward: area is (right - left) * min(h[left], h[right]); advance the shorter line.

problems.title: Maximum Average Subarray I
problems.description_short: Find a contiguous subarray of length k that has the maximum average value.
problems.learning_note: Fixed-size sliding window of width k: add incoming element and subtract outgoing element.

problems.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
problems.description_short: Find minimum length of contiguous subarray with sum at least target.
problems.learning_note: Variable-length sliding window: expand right to reach target sum, then shrink left to minimize window length.

problems.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
problems.description_short: Find length of longest substring with same letter after at most k character replacements.
problems.learning_note: Sliding window maintains max frequency of any char: valid when (windowLength - maxFreq) <= k.

problems.title: Permutation in String
problems.description_short: Determine if s2 contains a permutation of s1 as a substring.
problems.learning_note: Fixed sliding window of length s1.length comparing character frequency array matches.

problems.title: Range Sum Query - Immutable
problems.description_short: Design a data structure for fast range sum queries [left, right] on an immutable array.
problems.learning_note: Precompute prefix sum array: rangeSum(left, right) = prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left] in O(1).

problems.title: Permutations
problems.description_short: Generate all possible permutations of an array of distinct integers.
problems.learning_note: Backtracking by swapping elements or maintaining a visited set of length n.

problems.title: Combination Sum
problems.description_short: Find all unique combinations in candidates summing to target where elements may be reused.
problems.learning_note: Backtracking recursion allowing reuse of candidate[i] by not advancing index until branch exhausts.

problems.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
problems.description_short: Return all letter combinations that a phone number digits string could represent.
problems.learning_note: Backtracking maps each digit to its phone letters and branches recursively for each digit index.

problems.title: Word Search
problems.description_short: Determine if a word exists in an m x n board of characters.
problems.learning_note: 2D grid backtracking DFS: mark visited cells in-place and restore upon backtrack.

problems.title: Assign Cookies
problems.description_short: Maximize the number of content children satisfied by available cookies.
problems.learning_note: Sort greed factors and cookie sizes; satisfy the child with the smallest greed factor first.

problems.title: Lemonade Change
problems.description_short: Determine if you can provide correct change to every customer purchasing $5 lemonade.
problems.learning_note: Greedy: always prioritize giving $10 bills as change before $5 bills to preserve flexibility.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
problems.description_short: Maximize total profit from buying and selling stock multiple times.
problems.learning_note: Greedy approach: capture every positive price difference prices[i] - prices[i - 1].

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.description_short: Determine if you can reach the last index from the first index in jump game.
problems.learning_note: Greedy max reachable index: maxReach = max(maxReach, i + nums[i]); return false if i > maxReach.

problems.title: Jump Game II
problems.description_short: Find minimum number of jumps to reach the last index of nums.
problems.learning_note: Greedy BFS intervals: jump whenever current index reaches the end of current jump range.

problems.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problems.description_short: Find minimum number of intervals to remove to make the rest non-overlapping.
problems.learning_note: Interval scheduling: sort by end time; greedily keep intervals that finish earliest.

problems.title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
problems.description_short: Find minimum cost to reach top of floor where cost[i] is paid on step i.
problems.learning_note: DP state: dp[i] = cost[i] + min(dp[i - 1], dp[i - 2]) with constant space optimization.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.description_short: Maximize money robbed from houses along a street without robbing adjacent houses.
problems.learning_note: DP recurrence: rob[i] = max(rob[i - 1], rob[i - 2] + nums[i]); optimize with two variables.

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.description_short: Find fewest number of coins needed to make up a given amount.
problems.learning_note: Bottom-up 1D DP: dp[a] = min(dp[a], dp[a - coin] + 1) initialized to infinity.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.description_short: Find length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence in an array.
problems.learning_note: O(n²) DP dp[i] = max(dp[j] + 1), or patience sorting with binary search in O(n log n).

problems.title: Word Break
problems.description_short: Determine if string s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of dictionary words.
problems.learning_note: 1D DP boolean array: dp[i] is true if any prefix dp[j] is true and s[j...i] is in wordDict.

problems.title: Unique Paths
problems.description_short: Count unique paths for a robot to move from top-left to bottom-right of an m x n grid.
problems.learning_note: 2D DP: dp[r][c] = dp[r - 1][c] + dp[r][c - 1] with base cases dp[0][c] = 1, dp[r][0] = 1.

problems.title: Minimum Path Sum
problems.description_short: Find a path from top-left to bottom-right minimizing the sum of all numbers along its path.
problems.learning_note: 2D grid DP: grid[r][c] += min(grid[r - 1][c], grid[r][c - 1]) computed in-place.

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.description_short: Find length of the longest common subsequence between two strings text1 and text2.
problems.learning_note: 2D DP: if chars match, 1 + dp[i-1][j-1]; otherwise max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).

problems.title: Coin Change II
problems.description_short: Calculate number of combinations that make up a given amount using given coins.
problems.learning_note: Unbounded knapsack DP: outer loop on coins prevents duplicate permutation counting.

problems.title: Maximal Square
problems.description_short: Find the largest square containing only 1s in a binary matrix and return its area.
problems.learning_note: dp[r][c] = min(dp[r-1][c], dp[r][c-1], dp[r-1][c-1]) + 1 for cell containing '1'.

problems.title: Edit Distance
problems.description_short: Find minimum edit distance (insert, delete, replace) to convert word1 to word2.
problems.learning_note: Classic 2D DP: if chars match, dp[i-1][j-1]; else 1 + min(insert, delete, replace).

problems.title: Number of 1 Bits
problems.description_short: Return the number of set bits (Hamming weight) of a positive integer.
problems.learning_note: Brian Kernighan's algorithm: n &= (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit in each iteration.

problems.title: Counting Bits
problems.description_short: Calculate the number of 1 bits for every integer from 0 up to n in O(n) time.
problems.learning_note: DP bit relation: ans[i] = ans[i >> 1] + (i & 1).

problems.title: Reverse Bits
problems.description_short: Reverse bits of a given 32-bit unsigned integer.
problems.learning_note: Bit shifting: extract lowest bit (n & 1) and shift into result with (res << 1) | bit.

problems.title: Sum of Two Integers
problems.description_short: Calculate sum of two integers without using '+' or '-' operators.
problems.learning_note: Bitwise addition: sum = a ^ b (addition without carry), carry = (a & b) << 1; repeat until carry === 0.
